completed_stage_receipts.summary: Classified the user challenge as a real maintenance meta-method signal: prior bounded audits did not maintain a sufficiently broad architecture/reliability reference taxonomy. Named frameworks are evidence lenses, not user-mandated implementation choices.

Requirement: learn and persist architecture/reliability disciplines in a cold non-authoritative library, diagnose current Universal gaps, and make no refactor/behavior change until a later explicit user command.

Mapped lifecycle/decomposition, control/reconciliation, authority/change, inter/intra-owner interaction, execution environments, supervision/recovery, reliability governance, verification/coverage, formal correctness, hazards, evolution and resilience experiments across the current control plane.

Root cause is benchmark-scope blindness in the maintenance meta-method: a global audit can be locally complete while its question taxonomy omits mature architecture/control/safety/reliability families.
